# 0x25C — `imu_unknown`

DLC 4 · 100 Hz · status: **unknown**

Not decoded. The low nibble of B0 is always 1 and the high nibble takes all 16 values; the high nibble of B1 is always 1 and the low nibble takes all 16. Both sit at 5 at rest and spread out as speed rises. The low nibble of B1 correlates −0.61 with a low-passed roll rate; otherwise no correlation with lean, yaw or roll above 0.24. The low nibbles of B2 and B3 are 0xB in 97-99 % of frames while the high nibbles vary.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | — |
| B1 | — |
| B2 | — |
| B3 | — |
